Name: Alternate Anthro Shauna- Anthro Characters Continued Shane Genderswap Add-on
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
I've kitbashed together Male-to-Female Genderswap sprites and portraits for ShaneShauna  from the Anthro Characters Continued mod. I completed Alex/Alexis and Sebastian/Sabrina in previous mods.

I mashed them together through Shanes's original sprites from Sion9000/Gaveliere, the portraits created from  BetasEnjoyer11 (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/5082) , and the clothing and bodies is from Sion9000/Gaveliere's mod and the Shane Girl Mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1946). All used with permission.

All sprites are complete. After that I would bundle all of these mods together into a complete package.

Before I could create the Beach sprites, the actual ACC mod came out with its genderswaps. However, I still plan completed it as an exercise for myself.

I have had to take the Sabrina edition of this mod down for a bit until I can remove all assets I do not have permisison to use.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1. Download and install Anthro Characters Continued
2. Download this mod, unzip it, and place the folder inside into the Same Directory as your original Anthro Characters Continued patch. Accept Overwrites.

[b]Shout outs[/b]
BetasEnjoyer11 provided made the original portraits and gave me the original copies of them and let me use them!
